殖民地获得自治，贸易反而更加繁荣。: The colony became self-governing, and trade actually grew.
殖民地宣布独立，本土卸下了重担。: The colony declared independence, lifting a burden from the homeland.

报刊连篇累牍地批评政府，舆论沸腾。: The newspapers are filled with attacks on the government, and public opinion is boiling.
言论自由催生了新思想。: Free speech gave rise to new ideas.
报刊受到审查，舆论平息。: The press was censored, and the uproar died down.
几家大报转而为政府说话。: Several major papers now speak for the government.
各地纷纷上报祥瑞：甘露降、嘉禾生、凤凰现。: Good omens are reported from everywhere: sweet dew, giant grain, a phoenix sighting.
朝廷大赦天下，万民欢腾。: The court declared a general amnesty, and the people rejoiced.
朝廷改元以纪祥瑞。: The court named a new era to mark the good omens.
君主认为祥瑞不足为凭，更重实政（德望 +5）。: The ruler held that omens prove nothing and focused on real government (virtue +5).

怎么完成当前使命: How to complete the current mission
使命按顺序推进，完成当前一项才会开始下一项。完成后立即获得奖励，地图上会浮现朱印: Missions go in order: the next one starts when you finish the current one. You get the reward right away, and a red seal appears on the map.
扩大疆域。开拓国策让领土自然增长更快，也可以通过战争夺取邻国土地。: Expand your territory. The Expansion policy makes your land grow faster on its own, and you can also take land from neighbors in war.
夺取目标区域的土地{0}。领土会随国策自然扩张；如果那里已被别国占据，需要宣战攻: Take land in the target region{0}. Your territory grows on its own according to your policy; if another country already holds it, you need to declare war and take it.
用国库兴建奇观。国库每年都有收入，攒够造价后在奇观面板里兴建；若已被别国抢先，只: Build wonders with your treasury. The treasury earns income every year; once you can afford one, build it from the Wonders panel. If another country builds it first, the only way is to capture that city.
推动科技进步。文教国策和学问研发都能加快进度，发明类抉择也有帮助。: Advance technology. The Learning policy and the Scholarship focus both speed up progress, and invention decisions help too.
发展商贸。商路来自和平相处的邻国和远洋航线，避免与邻国开战，研发航海。: Grow trade. Trade routes come from neighbors at peace and from ocean routes. Avoid wars with neighbors, and research seafaring.
提高稳定。安民国策、赈济、贤明的君主和奇观都能提升稳定；战争、疆域过大和王朝老化: Raise stability. The Welfare policy, relief, wise rulers and wonders all raise stability; war, an oversized realm and an aging dynasty lower it.
守住国家，避免战乱。安民国策、少打仗、及时议和，等到目标年份即可。: Hold your country together and avoid war. Use the Welfare policy, fight little, make peace quickly, and wait for the target year.
结交盟友。先对邻国赠礼提高信任，再提议结盟；同宗教、有共同敌人时更容易成功。: Make allies. Send gifts to neighbors to build trust first, then propose an alliance. It works better with a shared faith or a common enemy.
拥有一种宗教。留意「先知」类抉择，或让信教的邻国把宗教传进来。: Have a religion. Watch for "Prophet" decisions, or let a neighbor with a faith spread it to you.
积累国库。商贸越兴旺，收入越多；少花钱在不必要的行动上。: Build up the treasury. The more trade thrives, the more you earn; don't spend on unnecessary actions.
派探险队去远方海岸建立据点，研发航海能增强远航能力。: Send explorers to build an outpost on a distant coast. Researching seafaring improves long voyages.
提高经济增长。增长优先国策最直接，同时避免战争和制裁。: Raise economic growth. The Growth first policy works best; also avoid war and sanctions.
推进能源转型。绿色转型国策最直接，核聚变突破也会大幅加速。: Push the energy transition. The Green transition policy works best, and a fusion breakthrough speeds it up a lot.
推动这一方向的科技。把研发重点设为该方向，并用国库进行“攻关”。: Push technology in this area. Set your research focus to it, and use the treasury for a "Research push".
